# merge

**Route Modulators · Consolidated family**

## Intuition

Allow inner work to overlap, optionally with a limit.

## Specification

Admit work while capacity is available; otherwise queue source values. Project queued values when admitted. Forward values from all active inners as they arrive.

### Lifetime and policy details

Default concurrency is unbounded. Outer completion waits for active and queued work. An inner error terminates the result and cancels the other work. Unsubscription closes active subscriptions; whether that aborts external work depends on producer teardown.

### Names represented

`merge`, `mergeAll`, `mergeMap`, `mergeMapTo`, `mergeWith`, `flatMap`.

### Configuration vocabulary

- `withProjection(project)`
- `withConcurrency(limit)`
- `withSources(...sources)`

These are available forms and modifiers, not a list to combine indiscriminately. See the [migration guide](/MIGRATION) for supported combinations and signatures.

## Example

This is a wiring sketch: streams and application functions such as `source$`, `isValid`, or `load` are supplied by your application. Import operators from `rxjs-80`, controls from `rxjs-80/controls`, and supporting types, Subjects, and schedulers from `rxjs`.

```typescript
requests$.pipe(merge(withProjection(load), withConcurrency(4)))
```

Building this expression does not subscribe. Connect a consumer to start the Observable execution; a live producer may already exist independently. [Run a complete example](/guide/getting-started#first-pipeline).
